name: Shinsetsu Ryouki no Ori
source: There is a string of 14 mysterious dissapearances in a single department store that started about 15 years ago. Police still can't find any clues. So store manager decided to hire a private detective to solve this strange case. He has only 9 days to finish his work.
translation: 大约15年前，一家百货商店开始接连发生神秘失踪事件，至今已有14人失踪，警方仍找不到任何线索。商店经理于是决定雇用一名私家侦探破解这起怪案，而他只有九天时间完成调查。
